decision: FALSIFIES — Frozen decision_rule triggers FALSIFIES on multiple clauses: C1 fails (60/240 byte-identical CDN decompression, 0.25 — only GZIP-OUTER with client Accept-Encoding containing gzip passes all 60 cells; all other 180 fail), C2 fails (header match 60/240, byte passthrough 40/240, silent HTML gzip re-encode under unchanged header, fixed-order streaming fails on all 180 transformed deliveries), C4 fails (5/15 identity byte-identical, CDN gzip-compresses JSON/HTML identity text when client accepts gzip — benign and reversible, BINARY identity 5/5 passthrough). C3 passes as consecutive-serve stability (6/6 triplets byte-stable across 1s reps; cf-cache-status DYNAMIC on all 273 CDN responses, no HIT observed — stale-cache serving not exercised). Positive control B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT passes 240/240 with 240/240 raw-byte passthrough, 0 transport errors — environment valid, CDN inferences licensed. All five baselines B-CDN-RAW-PASSTHROUGH (0/60), B-CDN-GZIP-ONLY (30/60), B-CDN-BROTLI-ONLY (0/60), B-CDN-IDENTITY (5/15), B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT (240/240) are correctly measured. Audit PASS confirms all recomputed metrics match producer. The diagnosed failure mode is CDN Accept-Encoding negotiation — Cloudflare transparently decodes/re-encodes origin Content-Encoding based on client advertisement: (1) gunzip when client omits gzip (GZIP-OUTER+AE br/none → inner-brotli bytes with CE absent), (2) always de-brotli (BROTLI-OUTER never byte-identical, text re-gzipped when client accepts gzip, octet-stream served as decoded inner-gzip with CE absent), (3) silent re-encode under unchanged header (HTML GZIP-OUTER+AE gzip → CE gzip but different bytes, still valid gzip of same inner content), (4) identity text gzip-compressed by CDN when client accepts gzip (CE gzip, reversible). No chunk-size effect (8192 vs 32 agree on all 48 cells). Key diagnostic: encoding-agnostic iterative full-body decode (try brotli → try gzip until identity) recovers ground truth on 24/24 JSON/HTML forensic CDN deliveries — the failure is in the fixed origin-order framing assumption, not byte corruption. However, encoding-agnostic decode was NOT a frozen condition; it is a hypothesis for the next experiment, not an established result. Claim ceiling bounded to: Cloudflare free tier, single edge (sjc01), 10KB nominal, depth 2, gzip L1 / brotli q4, sequential requests, no cache HIT observed. C-MEAS-VALID remains EXPERIMENTAL and is blocked from Product Core promotion pending encoding-agnostic decompression validated through the same CDN protocol.

claim_updates.reason: CDN byte-identity hypothesis FALSIFIED: fixed-origin-order iterative decompression produces byte-identical output on only 60/240 CDN observations (25%) due to Cloudflare Accept-Encoding negotiation (gunzip, de-brotli, silent re-encode, identity gzip-compress). The frozen decision rule's all-conditions-must-pass gate fails on C1/C2/C4. However, localhost correctness is untouched (positive control 240/240), the failure mode is diagnosed (fixed-origin-order framing assumption vs CDN transparency), and encoding-agnostic iterative decode recovers ground truth on 24/24 forensic JSON/HTML CDN deliveries (exploratory, not frozen). C-MEAS-VALID remains blocked from Product Core: encoding-agnostic decompression must be implemented, frozen, and validated through the same CDN protocol before promotion. Claim ceiling bounded to: Cloudflare free tier, single edge (sjc01), 10KB nominal, depth 2, gzip L1 / brotli q4, sequential, no cache HIT. The parent's localhost-established claims (iterative decompression, TE framing streaming, decompressor API streaming — all 840/840) are unaffected.

product_action: C-MEAS-VALID Product Core promotion BLOCKED. CDN Accept-Encoding negotiation breaks fixed-origin-order decompression. Next step: implement and validate encoding-agnostic decompression (sniff delivered bytes, try brotli→gzip until identity) through the same Cloudflare CDN protocol. The forensic evidence (24/24 recovery) suggests this fix has high probability of success.
next_question: Does encoding-agnostic iterative decompression (sniff delivered Content-Encoding or try brotli→gzip→identity until SHA256 matches ground truth) restore byte-identical correctness through Cloudflare CDN for all 48 payload×order×chunk×Accept-Encoding conditions — and does it generalize to depths 3-5 and payloads >100KB?
reason: The experiment is a valid scientific negative with a precise diagnosis: CDN Accept-Encoding negotiation transforms origin encoding (gunzip, de-brotli, silent re-encode, gzip identity) breaking the fixed-origin-order assumption. The forensic probe (24/24 JSON/HTML recovery via encoding-agnostic decode) bounds the damage and identifies a specific fix path. Localhost correctness is unaffected (240/240 positive control). The next experiment should implement encoding-agnostic decompression as a frozen condition and re-run through the same CDN protocol to close the CDN gate for C-MEAS-VALID.
